candidates.change_summary: Change the authorization check from owner equality to require caller is not the owner, reversing access control.
Remove the require check entirely so anyone can call withdrawAll.
Require that the caller is the zero address, making the call effectively impossible from EOAs and most contracts.
Transfer zero wei instead of the contract balance, leaving funds in the contract after call.
Transfer the balance to msg.sender instead of the provided _recipient address.
Send the contract balance to the owner address, ignoring the provided recipient parameter.
